verdict.rationale: Cake documents digital issuance and management of share certificates, offers holdings and transactional certificate types, and lets you link previously issued certificates to your records so shareholders can see them in their portal. E-signing is only documented for capital-raise instruments and option approvals, not for share certificates, and how a natively issued certificate stays tied to its specific cap table entry is only implied. Missing for 10: evidence of legally binding in-platform signing of share certificates, explicit documentation of a permanent certificate-to-cap-table-entry link for natively issued certificates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue electronic share certificates that are legally signed in-platform and permanently linked to the cap table entry they represent

citations.quote: Certificate management - Issue and manage share certificates digitally
Cake supports two certificate types to suit different record-keeping needs: holdings certificates and transactional certificates.
Upload and link them to keep your records consolidated. Shareholders will be able to access linked certificates in their My Cake portal.
